jordan_dev: Hey team — onboarding hit a weird pattern. SDK v0.9.2 on our side sometimes gets a 401 immediately after a successful token exchange, then a bunch of 429s a few seconds later. Using short-lived tokens from our auth service. Anyone seen token-exchange -> immediate rejection + burst throttle combo?
maria_cs: Sorry you're seeing that, Jordan. Can you paste the short seq of logs (token exchange response, then the first few SDK requests)? This helps us correlate with rate windows.
jordan_dev: sure — pasted below (sanitized):
```
POST /auth/token -> 200 {token: "ey...", expires_in: 30}
GET /v1/generate -> 401 {error: "invalid_token"}
GET /v1/generate -> 429 {error: "rate_limit"} x 12
GET /v1/generate -> 429
```
jordan_dev: note: our workers spin up 40 parallel connections during warmup.
dev_ex: thanks — two quick ideas: 1) clock skew or token TTL rounding can make a token look expired server-side immediately after minting; 2) a refresh race can produce many simultaneous auth checks which pushes you into our burst window. Do you refresh per-worker or centralize refresh?
jordan_dev: we refresh per-worker right now. each worker grabs its own token when starting.
alex_sre: amplifying dev_ex — our auth/throttle accounting counts each auth handshake + first downstream request as part of the initial fanout. If 40 workers request within the same 1s window you'll likely cross the ephemeral burst threshold and see 429s. 401s usually indicate either revocation or TTL mismatch.
dev_ex: quick mitigations you can try now: reduce parallelism during warmup (e.g., max 5 concurrent init requests), implement singleflight token refresh (one refresh for N workers), and add a small client-side leeway to token expiry (e.g., treat token as expiring 5s earlier). Example config we use: ```js
// pseudo-config for SDK
sdk.configure({
  tokenGraceMs: 5000,
  maxInitConcurrency: 5,
  refreshCoalesceWindowMs: 200
});
```
maria_cs: if you want, we can also temporarily increase your burst quota for 24h while you ramp. Do you want us to do that?
jordan_dev: yes please — would help for tomorrow's staged rollout. Also any quick jitter suggestion?
alex_sre: add randomized jitter to startup sleeps: Math.floor(Math.random()*200) ms between worker inits. Also keep warmup steady-state slower: spawn 2-3 per second instead of all at once.
deploy-bot: @maria_cs adjusted tenant "jetpack" burst quota: +3 rps for 24 hours (change-id: Q-78421).
maria_cs: done. @jordan_dev let me know when you've applied the SDK config; we can watch metrics together.
jordan_dev: applied the singleflight patch + lowered init concurrency. After ~15 minutes the 401s stopped and 429s dropped to near zero. Thanks! :tada:
maria_cs: awesome — want me to capture these mitigation steps in your onboarding playbook so renewals team can reference it?
jordan_dev: please do, that would be great. We'll also follow up with a short note on how our token service behaves (short TTL + central issuance).
dev_ex: we'll add a small SDK note about centralizing refresh and a recommended warmup pattern. Will open a follow-up ticket.
maria_cs: thank you, team. Jordan — good luck with prod rollout. Ping us if anything else pops up.
